segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct FullScreenCoverPresentedOnDismiss: View { @State private var isPresenting = false var body: some View { Button("Present Full-Screen Cover") { isPresenting.toggle() } .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $isPresenting, onDismiss: didDismiss) { VStack { Text("A full-screen modal view.") .font(.title) Text("Tap to Dismiss") } .onTapGesture { isPresenting.toggle() } .foregroundColor(.white) .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity) .background(Color.blue) .ignoresSafeArea(edges: .all) } } func didDismiss() { // Handle the dismissing action. } } ```
